pages.title: About
pages.text: Earth's natural satellite. Tier 1 rocket. Gravity is about 22% of Earth's, so you jump high and land softly. There is no air, but there is $(l:space/survival/hazards#radiation)solar radiation$().

pages.title: Landing
pages.text: You descend in a lander: follow the on-screen hint, then take your rocket and cargo out of it. First check your oxygen and remember the spot, as finding the lander at night is hard.

pages.title: Dangers
pages.text: At night, tougher space monsters come out. Falling meteors break blocks. Normal torches do not burn, so bring glowstone torches.

pages.title: What to look for
pages.text: Copper, tin and sapphires. Cheese ore is turned off here. Meteoric iron falls from the sky and you need at least a stack: $(l:space/survival/oxygen#airlock)air locks$() and later rockets need it. There are also Moon villages.

pages.title: The dungeon
pages.text: A skeleton boss lives under the surface. It is tougher than normal: it regenerates, summons monsters and blocks flying in its room. It drops a key. Use it to open the treasure room with the tier 2 schematic.

pages.title: Next
pages.text: Beating the boss opens the GalaxySpace advancement branch and the way to $(l:space/planets/mars)Mars$().

pages.title: Meteoric Iron
pages.text: Falls from the sky with meteors.

pages.title: Dungeon Locator
pages.text: Points the way to the dungeon.
